package interoperability_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/kafka"
	"github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/outbox"
	"github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/outbox/adapters/gokafka"
	outboxpostgres "github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/outbox/postgres"
	workflow "github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/workflow"
	workflowpostgres "github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/workflow/postgres"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	dockerclient "github.com/moby/moby/client"
	"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go"
	tckafka "github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/kafka"
	tcpostgres "github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/postgres"
	"github.com/twmb/franz-go/pkg/kadm"
	"github.com/twmb/franz-go/pkg/kgo"
)

const interoperabilityKafkaImage = "confluentinc/confluent-local:7.5.0@" +
	"sha256:8e391de42cfcd3498e7317dcf159790f1f1cc3f3ffce900b30d7da23888687fd"

func TestWorkflowAndOutboxShareOneAuthoritativeCommit(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	container, err := tcpostgres.Run(ctx, "postgres:18-alpine",
		tcpostgres.WithDatabase("workflow"),
		tcpostgres.WithUsername("workflow"),
		tcpostgres.WithPassword("workflow"),
		tcpostgres.BasicWaitStrategies(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("start PostgreSQL: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cleanupCtx, cleanupCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cleanupCancel()
		if terminateErr := container.Terminate(cleanupCtx); terminateErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("terminate PostgreSQL: %v", terminateErr)
		}
	})
	connection, err := container.ConnectionString(ctx, "sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PostgreSQL connection string: %v", err)
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, connection)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect PostgreSQL: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA workflow"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create workflow schema: %v", err)
	}
	for _, migration := range workflowpostgres.SchemaMigrations() {
		if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, migration.Up); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("apply workflow migration %d: %v", migration.Version, err)
		}
	}
	entries, err := fs.ReadDir(outboxpostgres.Migrations(), ".")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read outbox migrations: %v", err)
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		migration, readErr := fs.ReadFile(outboxpostgres.Migrations(), entry.Name())
		if readErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read outbox migration %s: %v", entry.Name(), readErr)
		}
		contents := string(migration)
		upMarker := "-- +migrations Up\n"
		downMarker := "-- +migrations Down\n"
		down := strings.Index(contents, downMarker)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(contents, upMarker) || down < len(upMarker) {
			t.Fatalf("outbox migration %s has invalid directives", entry.Name())
		}
		if _, execErr := pool.Exec(ctx, contents[len(upMarker):down]); execErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("apply outbox migration %s: %v", entry.Name(), execErr)
		}
	}

	workflowStore, err := workflowpostgres.New(pool, workflowpostgres.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct workflow store: %v", err)
	}
	outboxWriter, err := outboxpostgres.NewWriter(outboxpostgres.WriterConfig{Schema: "workflow"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct outbox writer: %v", err)
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 11, 14, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	definition, err := workflow.NewDefinition(workflow.DefinitionSpec{
		Name: "orders", Version: "1", Mode: workflow.Choreography,
		Steps: []workflow.StepSpec{{
			Name: "approved", Kind: workflow.StepSignal, Target: "orders.approved",
			Timeout: time.Hour, InputLimit: 64,
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct definition: %v", err)
	}
	startEvent, err := workflow.NewHistoryEvent(workflow.HistoryEventSpec{
		Sequence: 1, InstanceID: "order-1", Kind: workflow.EventInstanceStarted,
		OccurredAt: now, Definition: definition.Reference(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct start event: %v", err)
	}
	start, err := workflow.NewTransition(workflow.TransitionSpec{
		ID: "start-order-1", InstanceID: "order-1", Definition: definition.Reference(),
		Events: []workflow.HistoryEvent{startEvent},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct start transition: %v", err)
	}
	envelope := outbox.Envelope{
		ID: "publish-order-1", Topic: "orders.started", Payload: []byte(`{"order_id":"order-1"}`),
		PayloadVersion: 1, OrderingKey: "order-1", IdempotencyKey: start.ID(),
		Metadata:    map[string]string{"tenant_id": "tenant-1", "correlation_id": "correlation-1"},
		AvailableAt: now, CreatedAt: now,
	}

	stage := func(commit bool) {
		t.Helper()
		tx, beginErr := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if beginErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("begin shared transaction: %v", beginErr)
		}
		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
		if stageErr := workflowStore.Stage(ctx, tx, start); stageErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("stage workflow transition: %v", stageErr)
		}
		if insertErr := outboxWriter.Insert(ctx, tx, envelope); insertErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("stage outbox envelope: %v", insertErr)
		}
		if commit {
			if commitErr := tx.Commit(ctx); commitErr != nil {
				t.Fatalf("commit shared transaction: %v", commitErr)
			}
		}
	}
	stage(false)
	assertDurableCounts(t, ctx, pool, 0, 0)
	stage(true)
	assertDurableCounts(t, ctx, pool, 1, 1)
	var tenantID, correlationID, orderingKey, idempotencyKey string
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT metadata->>'tenant_id', metadata->>'correlation_id', ordering_key, idempotency_key
FROM workflow.outbox_messages WHERE id = $1`, envelope.ID).Scan(
		&tenantID, &correlationID, &orderingKey, &idempotencyKey,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read propagated outbox metadata: %v", err)
	}
	if tenantID != "tenant-1" || correlationID != "correlation-1" ||
		orderingKey != "order-1" || idempotencyKey != start.ID() {
		t.Fatalf("propagated outbox metadata = %q %q %q %q", tenantID, correlationID, orderingKey, idempotencyKey)
	}

	signal, err := workflow.NewSignalAcceptance(workflow.SignalAcceptanceSpec{
		InstanceID: "order-1", ExpectedSequence: 1, Definition: definition,
		StepName: "approved", SignalID: "message-1", ReceivedAt: now.Add(time.Second),
		Payload: []byte("approved"),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct inbound signal: %v", err)
	}
	if err := workflowStore.Commit(ctx, signal); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("commit signal before acknowledgement: %v", err)
	}
	if err := workflowStore.Commit(ctx, signal); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("deduplicate redelivered signal: %v", err)
	}
	query, err := workflow.NewHistoryQuery(workflow.HistoryQuerySpec{InstanceID: "order-1", Limit: 3})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct history query: %v", err)
	}
	page, err := workflowStore.History(ctx, query)
	if err != nil || len(page.Events()) != 2 || page.Events()[1].IdempotencyKey() != "message-1" {
		t.Fatalf("durable deduplicated signal = %#v, %v", page, err)
	}
}

func assertDurableCounts(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, workflows, envelopes int) {
	t.Helper()
	var workflowCount, envelopeCount int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT count(*) FROM workflow.workflow_instances").Scan(&workflowCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count workflow instances: %v", err)
	}
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT count(*) FROM workflow.outbox_messages").Scan(&envelopeCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count outbox envelopes: %v", err)
	}
	if workflowCount != workflows || envelopeCount != envelopes {
		t.Fatalf("durable counts = workflows %d envelopes %d, want %d and %d", workflowCount, envelopeCount, workflows, envelopes)
	}
}

func TestWorkflowOutboxPublicationRecoversFromALiveBrokerPartition(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 4*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	container, err := tckafka.Run(ctx, interoperabilityKafkaImage)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("start Kafka: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cleanupCtx, cleanupCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cleanupCancel()
		if terminateErr := container.Terminate(cleanupCtx); terminateErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("terminate Kafka: %v", terminateErr)
		}
	})
	brokers, err := container.Brokers(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve Kafka brokers: %v", err)
	}
	topic := fmt.Sprintf("workflow-outbox-partition-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	createInteroperabilityTopic(t, ctx, brokers, topic)
	producerConfig := interoperabilityProducerConfig(brokers, topic)
	producer, err := kafka.NewProducer(producerConfig)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct Kafka producer: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := producer.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("close Kafka producer: %v", closeErr)
		}
	})
	publisher, err := gokafka.New(producer)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct outbox Kafka publisher: %v", err)
	}
	beforePartition := outbox.Envelope{
		ID: "workflow-event-before-partition", Topic: topic,
		Payload: []byte(`{"sequence":1}`), PayloadVersion: 1,
		OrderingKey: "order-1", IdempotencyKey: "transition-1",
	}
	if err := publisher.Publish(ctx, beforePartition); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("publish before broker partition: %v", err)
	}

	docker, err := testcontainers.NewDockerClientWithOpts(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct Docker client: %v", err)
	}
	defer docker.Close()
	if _, err := docker.ContainerPause(
		ctx,
		container.GetContainerID(),
		dockerclient.ContainerPauseOptions{},
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("partition Kafka broker: %v", err)
	}
	paused := true
	defer func() {
		if paused {
			_, _ = docker.ContainerUnpause(
				context.Background(),
				container.GetContainerID(),
				dockerclient.ContainerUnpauseOptions{},
			)
		}
	}()
	duringPartition := outbox.Envelope{
		ID: "workflow-event-during-partition", Topic: topic,
		Payload: []byte(`{"sequence":2}`), PayloadVersion: 1,
		OrderingKey: "order-1", IdempotencyKey: "transition-2",
	}
	partitionCtx, partitionCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1500*time.Millisecond)
	partitionErr := publisher.Publish(partitionCtx, duringPartition)
	partitionCancel()
	if partitionErr == nil {
		t.Fatal("publish through broker partition succeeded")
	}
	var categorized interface{ Category() kafka.ErrorCategory }
	if !errors.As(partitionErr, &categorized) || !slices.Contains(
		[]kafka.ErrorCategory{kafka.ErrorRetryable, kafka.ErrorAmbiguous},
		categorized.Category(),
	) {
		t.Fatalf("broker partition outcome = %T, %v", partitionErr, categorized)
	}
	for _, broker := range brokers {
		if strings.Contains(partitionErr.Error(), broker) {
			t.Fatalf("broker partition diagnostic disclosed endpoint: %v", partitionErr)
		}
	}

	if _, err := docker.ContainerUnpause(
		ctx,
		container.GetContainerID(),
		dockerclient.ContainerUnpauseOptions{},
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("heal Kafka broker partition: %v", err)
	}
	paused = false
	waitForInteroperabilityKafka(t, ctx, brokers)
	waitForInteroperabilityTopic(t, ctx, brokers, topic)
	waitForInteroperabilityPublisher(t, ctx, publisher)
	if err := publisher.Publish(ctx, duringPartition); err != nil {
		var retryCategory interface{ Category() kafka.ErrorCategory }
		_ = errors.As(err, &retryCategory)
		t.Fatalf("retry after broker partition: category %v", retryCategory)
	}
	if err := publisher.Publish(ctx, duringPartition); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("redeliver uncertain outbox envelope: %v", err)
	}
	records := consumeInteroperabilityRecords(t, ctx, brokers, topic, 3)
	if got := []string{
		string(records[0].Value),
		string(records[1].Value),
		string(records[2].Value),
	}; !slices.Equal(got, []string{
		`{"sequence":1}`,
		`{"sequence":2}`,
		`{"sequence":2}`,
	}) {
		t.Fatalf("Kafka recovery order = %v", got)
	}
	for _, record := range records {
		if string(record.Key) != "order-1" {
			t.Fatalf("Kafka recovery key = %q", record.Key)
		}
	}
	if first, duplicate := interoperabilityHeader(records[1], "event-id"), interoperabilityHeader(records[2], "event-id"); first != duringPartition.ID || duplicate != duringPartition.ID {
		t.Fatalf("Kafka duplicate identity = %q and %q", first, duplicate)
	}
}

func interoperabilityProducerConfig(brokers []string, topic string) kafka.ProducerConfig {
	return kafka.ProducerConfig{
		Brokers: brokers, ClientID: "workflow-interoperability",
		AllowedTopics: []string{topic}, Security: kafka.DevelopmentPlaintextSecurity(),
		Limits: gokafka.DefaultLimits().Kafka, RecordRetries: 3,
		RetryBackoffMin: 25 * time.Millisecond, RetryBackoffMax: 100 * time.Millisecond,
		DeliveryTimeout: 5 * time.Second, ShutdownTimeout: 6 * time.Second,
		RequestTimeout: time.Second, DialTimeout: time.Second, Linger: time.Millisecond,
	}
}

func createInteroperabilityTopic(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, brokers []string, topic string) {
	t.Helper()
	client, err := kgo.NewClient(kgo.SeedBrokers(brokers...))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct Kafka admin client: %v", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	response, err := kadm.NewClient(client).CreateTopic(ctx, 1, 1, nil, topic)
	if err != nil || response.Err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create Kafka topic: response %#v error %v", response, err)
	}
}

func waitForInteroperabilityKafka(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, brokers []string) {
	t.Helper()
	client, err := kgo.NewClient(kgo.SeedBrokers(brokers...))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct Kafka readiness client: %v", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(250 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		probeCtx, probeCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Second)
		probeErr := client.Ping(probeCtx)
		probeCancel()
		if probeErr == nil {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatalf("wait for Kafka recovery: %v", ctx.Err())
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func waitForInteroperabilityPublisher(
	t *testing.T,
	ctx context.Context,
	publisher *gokafka.Publisher,
) {
	t.Helper()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(250 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		probeCtx, probeCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Second)
		probeErr := publisher.Health(probeCtx)
		probeCancel()
		if probeErr == nil {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatalf("wait for Kafka publisher recovery: %v", ctx.Err())
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func waitForInteroperabilityTopic(
	t *testing.T,
	ctx context.Context,
	brokers []string,
	topic string,
) {
	t.Helper()
	client, err := kgo.NewClient(kgo.SeedBrokers(brokers...))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct Kafka topic readiness client: %v", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	admin := kadm.NewClient(client)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(250 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		probeCtx, probeCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Second)
		details, listErr := admin.ListTopics(probeCtx, topic)
		probeCancel()
		detail, exists := details[topic]
		ready := listErr == nil && exists && detail.Err == nil && len(detail.Partitions) == 1
		for _, partition := range detail.Partitions {
			if partition.Err != nil || partition.Leader < 0 {
				ready = false
			}
		}
		if ready {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatalf("wait for Kafka topic recovery: %v", ctx.Err())
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func consumeInteroperabilityRecords(
	t *testing.T,
	ctx context.Context,
	brokers []string,
	topic string,
	want int,
) []*kgo.Record {
	t.Helper()
	client, err := kgo.NewClient(
		kgo.SeedBrokers(brokers...),
		kgo.ConsumeTopics(topic),
		kgo.ConsumeResetOffset(kgo.NewOffset().AtStart()),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct Kafka consumer: %v", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	records := make([]*kgo.Record, 0, want)
	for len(records) < want {
		fetchCtx, fetchCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
		fetches := client.PollFetches(fetchCtx)
		fetchCancel()
		if fetchErrors := fetches.Errors(); len(fetchErrors) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("consume Kafka records: %v", fetchErrors)
		}
		fetches.EachRecord(func(record *kgo.Record) {
			if len(records) < want {
				records = append(records, record)
			}
		})
		if fetches.NumRecords() == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("consume Kafka records: received %d of %d", len(records), want)
		}
	}
	return records
}

func interoperabilityHeader(record *kgo.Record, name string) string {
	for _, header := range record.Headers {
		if header.Key == name {
			return string(header.Value)
		}
	}
	return ""
}
